_readme: Schema and morning notes: src/content/SIMULATION.md. This file stays separate from edition.json. If storyId is not in today's edition, the block hides itself.
title: Four figures from OpenAI’s Images 2.6 post
intro: Move across four lines from OpenAI’s 4 November 2026 post. Each stop is one sentence. The page does not turn the week into a day, and it does not apply the six seconds to every image.
note: Every line on the control is from OpenAI’s post “Introducing Images 2.6,” dated 4 November 2026. The week is 4 billion images across ChatGPT, Codex and the API. The day is the post’s own next sentence, “more than half a billion,” which it calls an average. This control does not divide 4 billion by seven. “50 percent faster than before” does not name the earlier model, the prompt, or the quality setting. “As little as six seconds” is a different sentence: Flare, when quality is set to low. It is not a time for Sunburst, and it is not a time for Flare at medium, high, or any setting the post does not name. The post points to a pricing page and a system card. Neither is on this control. No price is printed in the post itself.
